主要内容: The document is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, which is a report of a foreign private issuer under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing includes information about the issuance of various senior global medium-term notes, Series E, by the Bank. These notes are linked to different indices, including the S&P 500 Index and the iShares Russell 2000 Index Fund, and have varying maturity dates ranging from 2013 to 2015. The filing also includes opinions from legal counsel regarding the validity of the notes under Canadian, Ontario, and New York law. The report is incorporated by reference into the Bank’s registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806). This document is a SEC filing from Royal Bank of Canada dated January 3, 2012. It is a report signed by authorized officers, Donald Dye and John Matthews, indicating compliance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing is part of the regulatory requirements for the bank, and it does not contain any specific financial results or market-related information. The document serves as an official record of the bank's compliance with U.S. securities regulations.
